jobs.title: Software Engineering & Development, Vice President
jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

The GM Risk and Capital Optimization Technology team is seeking an experienced and highly motivated **Senior DevOps Engineer** to join the TAROT platform team based in London.

This is a key technical role responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting the DevOps capabilities that underpin a suite of strategic risk and capital optimization solutions. The successful candidate will drive automation, improve software delivery processes, enhance operational resilience, and ensure the scalability, security, and reliability of the platform.

Working closely with software engineers, architects, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity teams, and business stakeholders, the Senior DevOps Engineer will play a critical role in modernizing development and deployment practices, streamlining release management, and supporting mission-critical applications within a highly regulated financial services environment.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **DevOps Engineering & Automation**

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-grade DevOps frameworks and best practices.
* Build and enhance CI/CD pipelines to support automated build, test, deployment, and release processes.
* Promote Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation-first approaches across application and platform environments.
* Automate operational processes, environment provisioning, and deployment activities to improve efficiency and reduce risk.
* Continuously improve software delivery lifecycle processes, deployment frequency, and release quality.

### **Source Control & Release Management**

* Manage and administer source code repositories, branching strategies, and release processes.
* Support application versioning, release governance, and deployment planning across multiple environments.
* Implement best practices for code promotion, artifact management, and release automation.
* Collaborate with development teams to ensure consistent development standards and deployment practices.

### **Environment & Platform Management**

* Support multiple application environments including development, testing, UAT, and production.
* Manage application hosting platforms and ensure platform stability, availability, and performance.
* Monitor platform health and proactively identify opportunities for optimization and improvement.
* Support disaster recovery, resilience, and business continuity requirements.

### **Infrastructure & Operations**

* Work closely with infrastructure, cloud, and security teams to ensure platforms are secure, scalable, and compliant.
* Manage Windows Server environments supporting business-critical applications.
* Administer and support IIS-hosted applications and web services.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment, and application performance issues across environments.
* Support capacity planning, performance tuning, and operational readiness initiatives.

### **Security & Compliance**

* Embed security controls and DevSecOps principles into the software delivery lifecycle.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise technology standards, risk controls, and operational procedures.
* Support platform vulnerability remediation, patch management, and audit requirements.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to enhance security automation and monitoring capabilities.

### **Collaboration & Leadership**

* Partner with software engineering teams to improve development workflows and deployment automation.
* Mentor and guide junior engineers on DevOps best practices and operational excellence.
* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to platform modernization initiatives.
* Act as a subject matter expert for DevOps tooling, automation, and operational support.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

### **Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

### **Experience**

* Significant experience in a DevOps, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering role.
* Proven experience designing and maintaining enterprise CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience supporting complex, business-critical applications in production environments.
* Strong experience working within financial services, banking, capital markets, or other regulated industries is highly desirable.
  

  

**Technical Skills**
--------------------

### **Essential**

* Strong experience with CI/CD tools and automated deployment frameworks.
* Extensive knowledge of source control systems and repository management.
* Strong Windows Server administration experience.
* Strong Microsoft technology stack expertise.
* Hands-on experience administering and supporting IIS (Internet Information Services).
* Experience with release management, deployment automation, and software delivery lifecycle management.
* Strong troubleshooting and operational support capabilities.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, and performance management tools.

### **Desirable**

* Python scripting and automation development.
* PowerShell scripting and Windows automation.
* Infrastructure as Code technologies.
* Experience with containerisation technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Cloud platform experience (Azure preferred).
* Experience with application monitoring and observability platforms.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices.
* Familiarity with SonarQube, security scanning, and code quality tooling.
* Experience supporting .NET and Microsoft-based application stacks.

**Personal Attributes**
-----------------------

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving technology environment.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence.
* Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Able to balance strategic initiatives with hands-on operational responsibilities.
  

  

**About State Street**
======================

  

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

  
  

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

  
  

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

  
  

Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers

jobs.title: Business Applications Developer
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for a Business Applications Developer to join our growing development team. This role is ideal for a developer with strong .NET skills who enjoys problem solving, debugging complex issues, and building business applications that deliver real value to customers.

You'll work on our suite of data quality and validation products, developing new features, maintaining existing solutions, and investigating technical issues across a range of Microsoft technologies.

While experience with Microsoft Power Platform and Dataverse would be advantageous, we're primarily looking for a strong developer with excellent troubleshooting skills and a willingness to learn.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain and enhance .NET applications, services and integrations.
* Investigate and resolve software defects, performance issues and technical problems.
* Work with APIs, data integrations and validation services.
* Contribute to new product development and ongoing platform improvements.
* Participate in sprint planning, code reviews and release activities.
* Create and maintain technical documentation where required.
* Work closely with other developers, product owners and support teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
* Assist with technical investigations relating to customer-reported issues where required.

**Essential Skills**

* Commercial experience developing with C# and .NET.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving ability.
* Experience working with SQL Server and relational databases.
* Experience developing or integrating REST APIs.
* Understanding of source control systems such as Git.
* Experience working in an Agile development environment.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively within a development team.

**Desirable Skills**

* Microsoft Dataverse & Power Platform Knowledge.
* Azure development and cloud services.
* JavaScript / TypeScript.
* Modern front-end development using React, TSX, Fluent UI and related technologies.
* Technical documentation experience.

**What We're Looking For**

We're more interested in finding a capable developer with strong fundamentals than someone who already knows every platform we use. If you're technically curious, enjoy debugging difficult problems and want to develop your skills within the Microsoft ecosystem, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: £35,000.00-£40,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Company events
* Company pension
* On-site parking
* Private medical insurance
* Work from home

Application question(s):

* Experience developing or integrating REST APIs.
* Nice to have Power Platform knowledge, or at least an understanding of what Power Platform is.
* Must have Commercial experience developing with C# and .NET. , with examples
* Must have experience speaking to both customers and internal stakeholders

jobs.title: Technical Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
**Position:**  
Technical Sales Engineer
  
  
**Job Description:**  
Technical Sales Engineer
  
  
ABOUT THE ROLE
  
  
This position sits within Arrow Global Components (AGC), a part of Arrow Electronics, and is responsible for building and maintaining influential relationships with customers, suppliers, and Arrow partners to create demand for Arrow products. The role combines demand creation, account management, and relationship development, with a strong focus on proactively offering engineering and supply chain solutions and matching Arrow’s solutions to customer business needs.
  
  
**WHAT WILL YOU DO:**  

* Build and maintain influential relationships with customers, suppliers, and Arrow partners to create demand for Arrow products.
* Identify technical needs of complex, emerging, or underpenetrated prospects and match Arrow’s solutions to customer business needs.
* Drive and create new opportunities and product selection within assigned accounts, using other technical resources as needed.
* Initiate and schedule regular visits to customer facilities, gain a solid understanding of customer needs, and translate those needs into Arrow requirements or business opportunities.
* Execute solution selling through a working knowledge of Arrow’s supply chain solutions and design processes, with emphasis on demand creation and engineering.
* Stay current on product knowledge and related technologies, attend supplier training events, and maintain supplier databases and design registration information accurately.

**WHO YOU ARE:**  

* Higher degree, ideally in Engineering, combined with a strong interest in technology and innovation.
* Around 5 years of experience in the electronics industry is preferred.
* Innovative and fresh approach to business development, with the ability to introduce changes and new solutions supported by business justification.
* Well-developed interpersonal and communication skills, as well as strong problem-solving, diplomacy, and influencing skills.
* Professional and proactive attitude.
* Goal-oriented mindset.
* Business fluent English is a must.

**WHAT WE OFFER:**  

* Competitive base salary with a performance-based bonus structure.
* Company car.
* Hybrid work model with flexible working hours.
* Private medical care (Medicover) and the MyBenefit platform, including Multisport.
* Career development opportunities within a global organization.
* Participation in key industry conferences and technology events.
* Supportive, international, and open corporate culture.

**WHO WE ARE:**  
AsArrow Global Components(AGC), a part of Arrow Electronics, we are a leader in distribution and value-added services related to electronic components. We resell, customize, and distribute electronic components to our clients all over the world. Our business is based on a trusted, long-lasting net of relationships with industry leaders, both on the supplier and customer side.
  
  
Arrow is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to create a diverse working environment by providing equal employment opportunity for all qualified persons.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
**Info**
--------

Location:

Fornebu, Norway

Apply by:

October 26, 2026

Position type:

Permanent

Job ID #:

21921

**Would you like to be part of a team seeking to transform the energy sector?**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

At Aker Solutions we are changemakers with nearly 200 years of experience, committed to helping the energy industry #PowerTheChange towards a net-zero future.

We are driven by collaboration and curiosity, building tomorrow’s technological solutions today!

Artificial intelligence is changing how we design, engineer and operate complex energy infrastructure. At Aker Solutions, we turn the possibilities of AI into real-world impact by integrating advanced technology across systems, disciplines and industrial workflows, where reliability, scale and measurable results matter.

We are now looking for an **AI Solutions Engineer** to join our team in our **Oslo** or **Stavanger** offices.

Join us in developing practical AI solutions that help our people make better decisions, work more efficiently and solve some of the energy industry’s most complex challenges. You will become part of a collaborative environment where domain expertise, data and technology come together to build solutions designed for the real world.

**What will you be doing?**
---------------------------

* Design and deliver AI-powered applications, agents and copilots that solve real business challenges across engineering, operations and corporate functions
* Build and orchestrate agent workflows, integrating APIs, enterprise systems, tools and data sources to create scalable and reliable solutions
* Identify and apply the right technology approach for each use case, working across both pro-code and low-code AI platforms and adapting as new capabilities emerge
* Design prompts, instructions, retrieval strategies and context mechanisms that improve the quality, grounding and relevance of AI-generated outputs
* Evaluate and improve AI solutions through testing, guardrails, monitoring and evidence-based validation to ensure safe and effective use in production
* Collaborate in cross-functional delivery teams alongside developers, data engineers, subject matter experts and business stakeholders to take solutions from idea to deployment

**We think you should have:**
-----------------------------

* A bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology or related field. Relevant professional experience may compensate for a lack of formal education
* Experience developing software applications, integrations or digital products, with hands-on exposure to AI, GenAI, agentic workflows, copilots, RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) and/or related technologies
* Strong understanding of APIs, system integration, application architecture and modern software development practices
* Experience designing AI solutions that combine prompts, context, tools, data and business knowledge to solve practical problems
* A curious and adaptable mindset with a passion for exploring new technologies, learning quickly and turning emerging AI capabilities into business value
* Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Norwegian language skills are considered an advantage

**What we offer:**
------------------

At Aker Solutions we are committed to creating an enjoyable, rewarding, and engaging career where you can thrive. Our aim is to build a long-term mutually beneficial relationship with you, in order to motivate and retain your talent. We offer a variety of global and local initiatives which support your well-being and development, so that you feel valued throughout your career – professionally and personally.

Some of them are:

* **Solid pension and insurance coverage**: We take care of our employees by offering competitive pension, insurance, and health plans that ensure your well-being today and in the future.
* **Well-being**: Enjoy access to free fitness facilities, sport groups and equipment rental, and a variety of cabins for rent.
* **Remote work flexibility**: Work from home up to two days per week, offering you the convenience and work/life balance you need.
* **Vibrant Young Professional network**: Connect, grow and thrive in our international community, Young Solutioneers.

**Apply Now!**
--------------

If this sounds like your next career move, we would love to hear from you!

Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis, and candidates may be contacted during the application period. Candidates are encouraged to apply without delay.

If you have questions about the position, feel free to reach out to:

* Ben Litvak, Senior Recruiter NES Advantage Solutions, tel. +47 913 61 050

NES Advantage Solutions is Aker Solutions’ global recruitment services provider responsible for permanent and temporary staffing services.

Please note: Background checks are conducted as part of our recruitment process on all final candidates for all roles. Furthermore, depending on the role, a risk assessment including an assessment of affiliation to high-risk countries where relevant may be carried out in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, clients and company requirements.

To protect your privacy, we kindly ask that you submit your application through our recruitment portal.

**Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------

At Aker Solutions, we foster an environment where everyone can thrive. Diversity fuels creativity and innovation, making it a key competitive advantage. We embrace all aspects of diversity, including disabilities, religion, sexual orientation, and more. We have experience with accommodating various needs and are always open to finding solutions that suit you. We encourage everyone to apply and are here to support you throughout the recruitment process.

**This is Aker Solutions**
--------------------------

Aker Solutions delivers integrated solutions, products and services to the global energy industry. We enable low-carbon oil and gas production and develop renewable solutions to meet future energy needs. By combining innovative digital solutions and predictable project execution we accelerate the transition to sustainable energy production. Aker Solutions employs approximately 11,800 people in 13 countries.

jobs.title: Senior C#/.NET Software Engineer | Banking & Investment Technology | Singapore
jobs.description:
**Senior C#/.NET Software Engineer | Banking & Investment Technology | Singapore**

Are you an experienced C# engineer looking to build technology that directly supports global investment activity?

I’m partnering with a leading global investment organisation to hire a Senior Software Engineer for its Singapore technology team.

You’ll build secure, scalable applications supporting investment management, trading, operations and risk. Working closely with product owners, business teams and investment professionals, you’ll translate complex requirements into reliable technology solutions with visible business impact.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Design and build applications using C#, .NET Core and ASP.NET Core

* Develop APIs and modern user interfaces using Angular or React

* Build solutions supporting investment and operational workflows

* Own delivery from system design and hands-on coding through testing, deployment and production support

* Work directly with product owners, engineers and senior business stakeholders

* Review code and help maintain strong engineering standards

* Explore practical applications of cloud, AI and emerging technologies

* Mentor engineers and provide technical direction where required

**What We’re Looking For**

* At least five years of software engineering experience

* Strong C#, .NET Core and ASP.NET Core expertise

* Experience with Angular or React and RESTful APIs

* Experience within a global bank, private bank, investment firm, fintech, payments or transaction-processing environment

* Strong knowledge of software design, testing and production support

* Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder-management skills

* A hands-on engineering mindset and ownership of production systems

* Candidates must currently be based in Singapore

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to investment management, trading, treasury, accounting or risk platforms

* Experience with AWS or Azure, Docker and Kubernetes

* Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical delivery

* An interest in machine learning, AI and emerging technologies

**Why Join?**

* Build technology supporting investment activity on a global scale

* Work directly with investment professionals and senior stakeholders

* Gain exposure across investment, risk, data and enterprise technology

* Take ownership of meaningful systems with visible business impact

* Join a stable, collaborative and technology-driven environment

* Benefit from a hybrid working arrangement

Please apply with your latest resume or get in touch for a confidential conversation.

BAH Partners specialises in placing world-class technology and quantitative talent across Asia-Pacific’s leading financial institutions and technology-driven organisations.
